review_evidence: README identifies the Tutorial and Solution trees as Lean teaching material covering propositional logic, quantifiers, injectivity/surjectivity, real analysis, group theory, group actions and quotients, and category theory, with Solution files containing formal exercise solutions.
Tutorial and solution files are searchable formal examples/proofs rather than documentation-only material and therefore remain prior art under FILTER-011.

The primary lakefile.lean also contains an actual Lean definition (moreServerArgs) and package configuration, so FILTER-008 does not permit treating it as non-formal build metadata. No safe primary exclusion remains.
summary: Retain the Lean mathematics workshop tutorials, worked solutions, and formal project configuration.
